February 9, 2026

# shopify.app.extensions() in App Bridge now supports POS UI extensions

DateFebruary 9, 2026

FlagsUpdate

SurfacesAPI

Affected APIs[App Bridge](https://shopify.dev/changelog?api_type=app-bridge)[POS Extensions](https://shopify.dev/changelog?api_type=pos-extensions)

The [`shopify.app.extensions()` method in App Bridge](https://shopify.dev/docs/api/app-home/apis/app) now supports **Point of Sale (POS) UI extensions**, in addition to checkout, customer account, Admin, and Theme extensions.

With this update, your embedded app can query the status of POS UI extensions along with other extension surfaces. This enables you to consistently handle and activate your Point of Sale extensions, simplifying the creation of onboarding flows and setup dashboards that encompass your entire app extension ecosystem, including in-store experiences.

For more information, refer to the [developer documentation](https://shopify.dev/docs/api/app-home/apis/app).
